name: tinyjson
description: Small recursive-descent JSON parser with a value tree and a CLI (src/jsoncat.c).

versions.message: tinyjson 1.1: drop the non-standard comment skipper

bugs.title: Heap buffer overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies characters into `out` without comparing `n` against `outlen`, so a string longer than the caller's buffer writes past its end.

bugs.title: Read past end of input in {fn}()
bugs.summary: When a string ends in a lone backslash, `{fn}()` reads the escaped character without checking that one byte remains.
bugs.poc: Parse the 3-byte input "\ with no closing quote.

bugs.title: Stack buffer overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` accumulates digits into a 64-byte stack buffer with no length limit, so a long numeric literal overwrites the stack.
bugs.poc: Parse a number literal of 200 digits.

bugs.title: Uncontrolled recursion in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` frees nested arrays recursively with no depth bound, so a deeply nested document exhausts the stack on cleanup.
bugs.poc: Parse 100000 nested '[' characters and free the result.

bugs.title: Integer overflow in {fn}() growth
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` doubles the capacity and multiplies by the element size without an overflow check, so the reallocation can be smaller than the index later written.
bugs.poc: Grow an array past 2^60 elements on a 64-bit build (or 2^29 on 32-bit).

bugs.title: NULL pointer dereference in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` stores the result of strdup without checking it, and the key array is later read as if every slot were valid.
bugs.poc: Parse a large object under an allocator that fails after N allocations.

bugs.title: Out-of-bounds read in {fn}()
bugs.summary: After skipping whitespace, `{fn}()` reads `*lx->p` without checking that the cursor is still inside the input.
bugs.poc: Parse the truncated input [1, ending right after the number.

bugs.title: Stack overflow via object keys in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` lexes keys into a 256-byte stack array, but the lexer ignores the length it is given, so a long key overflows the stack frame.
bugs.poc: Parse an object whose key is 1000 bytes long.

bugs.title: Over-read when copying strings in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` copies `n + 1` bytes from the temporary buffer, but the terminator is only written when `n` is below the buffer size.
bugs.poc: Parse a string value of exactly 256 bytes.

bugs.title: Unbounded nesting depth in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` initialises a depth counter that nothing ever checks, so recursion depth is controlled entirely by the input.

bugs.title: Truncated UTF-8 encoding overflow in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` writes a two-byte sequence for every code point above 0x7F, silently truncating values that need three bytes and writing past one-byte output buffers.
bugs.poc: Call it with "20AC" and a 1-byte output buffer.

bugs.title: Unterminated comment read overrun in {fn}()
bugs.summary: `{fn}()` scans for the closing */ without checking the end pointer, so an unterminated comment reads past the input buffer.
bugs.poc: Parse the input [1 /* with no closing delimiter.
